formDescription: BC Fishing Licence Application form, rendered by Form.io/CHEFS. Information about the angler, licence type, fishing region, optional classifications, and conservation surcharge stamps will be collected in this form.

angler_date_of_birth.title: Date of Birth
angler_date_of_birth.description: Angler's date of birth. Used to determine age eligibility and applicable licence rate.

residency_status.title: Residency Status
residency_status.description: Whether the applicant resides in British Columbia, elsewhere in Canada, or outside Canada. Determines the applicable licence fee.

fish_and_wildlife_id.title: Fish and Wildlife ID (WID)
fish_and_wildlife_id.description: Applicant's Fish and Wildlife ID. Leave blank if the applicant needs to register for a new WID.

licence_duration.title: Duration
licence_duration.description: Duration of the fishing licence being requested.

senior_resident_rate.title: I am 65 or older (resident annual rate)
senior_resident_rate.description: Select this option if the applicant is 65 years of age or older and qualifies for the resident annual rate.

disability_fee_reduction_eligibility.title: I hold a Certificate of Eligibility for the fee reduction program (severe and permanent disability)
disability_fee_reduction_eligibility.description: Select this option if the applicant holds a Certificate of Eligibility for the fee reduction program due to severe and permanent disability.

coe_number.title: Certificate of Eligibility Number
coe_number.description: The number of the Certificate of Eligibility for the fee reduction program.

fishing_region.title: Fishing Region
fishing_region.description: Fishing region where the applicant intends to fish.

options.label: Region 1 - Vancouver Island (includes Haida Gwaii: WMU 6-12, 6-13)

classified_waters_licence.title: Add a Classified Waters Licence
classified_waters_licence.description: Whether the applicant wants to add a Classified Waters Licence for a Class I or Class II water.

classified_waters_name.title: Classified Waters Licence Name
classified_waters_name.description: The name of the Classified Waters Licence the applicant wants to add.

conservation_surcharge_stamps.title: Conservation Surcharge Stamps
conservation_surcharge_stamps.description: Optional conservation surcharge stamps the applicant wants to add. Multiple may be selected.

estimated_licence_cost.title: Estimated Licence Cost
estimated_licence_cost.description: Estimated total licence cost based on selected licence type, region, and optional surcharges.
